profiles.scope: Pinned text source semantics; selection tests cover only named methods, not whole engine.
Target extension vocabulary, with pinned Luoyacheng/legado source evidence and explicit host contracts. The private sample remains static shape evidence, not proof of live-source execution.
Must report unknown fields/API explicitly; cannot auto-label as supported.

features.evidence: Metadata fields and data helpers, lazy variableMap, the 10000-character small/big split, nullable writes and changed metadata cross rule stages and IPC. DOM methods/overloads use closed native facades. Reader-global UI, Room and Parcelable machinery are explicit non-data ports in sources/rhino/README.md.

features.requirement: @js:/<js>、jsLib、Rhino 类型和异常、同步宿主桥接；引擎使用固定版本 1.8.1。
features.evidence: Rhino 1.8.1 runs global-completion scripts, ordered external jsLib segments, nested rule scripts and request templates with shared budgets and source-owned library state. Worker tools and bounded login/browser/discovery ports are implemented and covered by their own feature entries below. This is the bounded novel-source data profile, not arbitrary Java interoperability.

features.requirement: URL 模板/相对路径、页面参数、编码/charset、方法/body/header/重定向与 retry。
features.evidence: RequestCompiler and worker ScriptRequestTemplates handle URL/charset/page templates, methods, bodies, source headers, redirects and bounded retries. Browser options now pass to the existing broker browser port. get/head/post deliberately require absolute URLs and expose the first response, matching the pinned Jsoup entry points.

features.requirement: java.ajax/ajaxAll/connect/get/head/post，响应体/头、来源限流、取消、授权与真实请求目标检查。
features.evidence: SourceExecutionBroker uses source-owned permissions, request/rate/byte budgets, cancellation and revocation-guarded commits. Actual local HTTP, response bytes/charset, same-domain accounts, dynamic headers, browser headers, batch ordering and redirect semantics are tested. Browser subprocess behavior requires the Android checks as well as the JVM contracts.

features.requirement: enabledCookieJar、cookie/getCookie、请求头优先级、同域不同来源账号隔离。
features.evidence: SourceSession/SourceCookies own the automatic jar, explicit Cookie APIs, header precedence and account persistence. Logout revokes old commits and removes only that source's authentication. Local HTTP plus real browser/Binder tests cover same-domain sources, path ordering, HttpOnly, cookie-disabled sources and late responses.

features.requirement: cache get/put/delete、source 变量/配置与受限存储、TTL/配额；不得访问宿主仓库。
features.evidence: Source/config/content/resources and general browser localStorage belong to the source/profile; LoginInfo, LoginHeader and Cookie stores belong to the account generation. Quotas, TTL, explicit deletion, revoked writes and reconstruction are tested. Logout retains books, reading progress, content/images and source.put/cache values; ordinary cache TTL and eviction still apply.

features.requirement: JsEncodeUtils 和 JsExtensions 的 base64/hex/hash/字节/charset、时间/URL/HTML 与繁简转换。
features.evidence: Pinned encoding/hash/crypto/text operations, t2s/s2t dictionaries, charset detection, chapter-number normalization and JsURL data parsing are implemented. Contract tests and API24/35 tests exercise actual providers; target methods are covered by the module tests.

features.requirement: importScript/cacheFile/downloadFile、读取/解压/目录和字体工具通过受控资源服务实现。
features.evidence: Scoped resources support imports/downloads/reads/deletes, archive entries and atomic logical directories. Android uses pinned libarchive for ZIP/RAR/7z; JVM harness uses ZIP. Font tables/glyphs are checked before allocation; bounded cmap format 12 is a deliberate extension with U+100000 fixtures. Raw java.io.File access is outside the broker data profile.

features.requirement: loginUrl/login()、loginUi 表单、loginCheckJs、登录头/信息和账号代次。
features.evidence: RuleSource and SourceLoginService run static forms, loginUrl/login(), loginCheckJs response hooks, login information/headers and browser login under one revision/account attempt. UI starts the new account before evaluating its form; cancellation/removal/revision changes cannot revive the previous attempt. Dynamic source headers and image verification are exercised through production worker/broker paths.

features.requirement: WebView 渲染/DOM 返回、startBrowserAwait/验证码和会话同步。
features.evidence: AndroidSourceBrowser and the disposable SourceBrowserService implement DOM rendering, foreground startBrowser/Await, image getVerificationCode and source Cookie synchronization. API 24/35 instrumentation exercises actual Chromium, Binder, dynamic headers, POST login and manually entered verification text. JVM bridge doubles only prove dispatch/contracts; they are not the platform acceptance result.

features.requirement: Cookie/localStorage/Service Worker/子资源网络和迟到回调隔离，最低系统版本验证。
features.evidence: One disposable browser process owns the WebView directory, including API 24. Native network/file/content access, Service Workers, frames and WebSockets cannot bypass the broker; browser fetch/XHR/forms use checked source requests. API 24/35 tests verify same-domain source separation, preserved source localStorage after logout, denied worker registration, late-cookie cancellation and process-directory cleanup.

features.requirement: 可终止进程、IPC 来源身份、CPU/内存/输出/文件/网络预算，反射/类加载边界。
features.evidence: The #86 execution boundary has real isolated-UID Binder/INTERNET denial, namespace-bound authority and lifecycle hooks, guarded local commits, deadlines, bounded/depth-checked IPC, JVM pipe/heap limits, recursion controls and sampled Android allocation termination/recovery. The sampling budget is not an instantaneous RSS/mapping cap; see sources/execution/README.md. New #87 capabilities must extend the same boundary and add their fixtures.

features.requirement: java.upConfig/upLoginData/reLoginView/refreshExplore/showBrowser/open/searchBook 及配置/theme 快照等扩展动作；逐项定义受控协议。
features.evidence: Bounded data-only actions map to current-source forms, coalesced refresh, settings/login, source-local search/results and the existing permissioned browser/Cookie ports. Current-source searchBook object overload, invocation ownership, limits and lifecycle cancellation are tested. Theme/reader data are host snapshots, not Android handles. upConfig has documented product-defined source-local semantics; exact upstream overload equivalence is unresolved. Unknown actions/fields fail with locations; no arbitrary UI DSL or global-setting mutation. See sources/content/DISCOVERY.md.

features.requirement: androidId/randomUUID 等标识工具的权限和来源边界；跨设备稳定性及与外部认证契约的差异必须明示。
features.evidence: randomUUID produces a fresh version-4 UUID. Broker androidId returns a persisted 16-hex source/profile installation pseudonym, stable across account/revision changes and distinct after source/profile/app-data changes. It does not disclose the global system Android ID; external authentication requiring that literal upstream identifier is not claimed compatible. Neither identifier grants execution authority.

features.requirement: java.log/logType/toast/longToast、阶段/位置/版本错误、取消和脱敏，未知 API 不静默成功。
features.evidence: ContentTrace and bounded script logging retain redacted stage, field and error information in the reading runtime. Cancellation and unknown APIs remain failures. The app does not provide a source-testing screen or diagnostic-report export.

features.requirement: 规则身份与版本/profile 分离，更新原子激活、回退、权限新增、并发请求修订校验。
features.evidence: SourceRevisionUpdates validates a staged definition and grants before atomically publishing an installed snapshot/registry replacement. Stable source/book IDs survive updates; failed initialization, permissions or durable writes leave the old runtime usable. Removal during validation cannot be undone, and old tickets cannot commit into the replacement.

features.requirement: 内置+标准+目标扩展直接导入后搜索/阅读/任务/模式/离线闭环，必需能力不得静默降为非目标。
features.evidence: MixedSourceAcceptanceTest runs actual Wenku8 parsing and directly imported standard/extension definitions with a real WorkerRuntime/wire/broker, one file Room database and WorkManager. Same-domain/same-book rule sources complete login, discovery/search, shelf, cache, EPUB, reading statistics, updates, account revocation, reconstruction and removal. Both real reader controllers render retained source-owned chapters through the production decoder/injector after removal. External documents/settings are controlled fixtures; no public novel website or private account is used. Separate API 24/35 tests provide Chromium/process evidence.
